summary: Frontend E2E testing of CD Trofense confirms the P0 fix (EvaluationForm crash) is resolved. Login → Dashboard (18 atletas) → Athlete profile → open 'Nova avaliação' dialog → live metrics computed → save → history increments → all tabs (Avaliações, Pesagens, Fotos, Objetivos) render without crashes. All 3 photo slots (Frente/Perfil/Costas) with correct data-testids and hidden file inputs are present in the evaluation form.
passed: Login with admin@trofense.pt / Trofense2026! redirects to Dashboard
Dashboard lists exactly 18 atletas as table rows (athlete-row-0..17)
Click athlete row navigates to /atletas/{id} and shows athlete-header-name (André Gomes)
AthleteProfile KPI cards render (kpi-peso, kpi-mg, kpi-mg-kg, kpi-lean, kpi-mm, kpi-mmmg, kpi-imc, kpi-soma8 — 8 KPIs)
P0 FIX VERIFIED: click new-eval-btn opens Dialog 'Nova avaliação · André Gomes' WITHOUT compile crash / white screen
Dialog contains section 'FOTOS (opcional · ficam associadas a esta avaliação)' with 3 visible slots
All 3 photo slot testids present: eval-photo-slot-frontal / -perfil / -costas
All 3 hidden file inputs present: eval-photo-input-frontal / -perfil / -costas
Form fields present: eval-date, eval-weight, eval-age, preg-* (10), per-* (6), save-eval-btn

P1 VERIFIED: filling peso=70 + pregas + perimetros computes live metrics (20 non-dash values including R&W 11.72%, JP7 8.98%, Evans7 10.72%, Evans3 11.53%, Withers 11.93%, MM 34.61kg, IMC 21.85, Σ8 79) — NOT all '—'
Saving evaluation closes the Dialog and Histórico count increments from (1) to (2)
Comparativo entre métodos section shows all 5 methods (R&W, JP7, Evans7, Evans3, Withers)
Aba Fotos: PhotosPanel renders with photos-eval-selector dropdown and 3 photo slots (photo-input-frontal/perfil/costas + upload-*-btn) — no crash
Aba Pesagens: WeighinsPanel renders (Nova pesagem, Evolução chart, Histórico) — no crash
Aba Objetivos: GoalsPanel renders (% MG alvo input, Atual/Peso atual/Peso alvo, Progresso bar) — no crash
No pageerror events; only benign warnings: Radix Dialog aria-describedby (a11y) and Recharts width/height=-1 during initial render (harmless)

issues: A11y: DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description (Radix warning). Not blocking, but recommended to add DialogDescription.
Recharts logs 'width/height=-1' warnings on initial render (ResponsiveContainer measures 0 while dialog animates). Purely cosmetic — charts still render correctly after layout settles.

action_items: OPTIONAL a11y polish: add <DialogDescription> inside DialogHeader of Nova avaliação (silences Radix warning).
OPTIONAL: give EvaluationCharts' ResponsiveContainer a minHeight to eliminate Recharts warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: EvaluationForm.jsx (241 LOC) is now clean — no duplicate JSX fragment; photoBlobs/photoPreviews/cropState state and 3-slot photo section are correctly wired to PhotoCropDialog and posted with evaluation_id after eval creation.
Photo upload runs after the eval POST returns newEval.id — good ordering; per-photo failures are caught with toast and do not block save (acceptable UX).
URL.revokeObjectURL is called on cleanup and on cancel — no obvious blob leaks.
AthleteProfile.jsx: Dialog for new eval opens/closes via controlled state newEvalOpen — correct.
Minor: consider adding data-testid on Dialog title/description for stronger test targeting (currently we rely on role='dialog' text).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 new evaluation for athlete 'André Gomes' during the save-flow test (Peso 70 + full pregas/perimetros). Histórico went from (1) to (2). Please delete this test evaluation if it pollutes demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 crash on EvaluationForm.jsx is fixed and end-to-end save flow works. Real file upload via PhotoCropDialog was NOT exercised in headless (per request); slots and inputs verified present. If retesting photos: use setInputFiles on [data-testid='eval-photo-input-frontal'], expect PhotoCropDialog to open (react-easy-crop), then a Guardar button inside the crop dialog to produce a Blob. Backend POST /api/athletes/{aid}/photos accepts multipart with fields: file, date, kind, evaluation_id.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous crash was caused by leftover duplicate JSX fragment (lines 186-190) in EvaluationForm.jsx. Fix by main agent: removed the fragment and added state (photoBlobs, photoPreviews, cropState, fileRefs) plus a 3-slot fotos section rendering PhotoCropDialog. Verified: dialog opens, live metrics compute, save persists, history increments.
